description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Use when an agent asks what meme coins are trending/pumping on Base, BNB Chain (bsc) or Solana pump.fun. Ranked by volume x spike: price, change, buys/sells, liquidity, pool age, go/caution/avoid verdict. From on-chain swap logs. Returns JSON ranked meme coins: price, change, buys and sells, liquidity, pool age, and a go, caution, or avoid verdict.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

chain.description: Chain to rank. Format: one of the allowed values. Example: base. Allowed values: base, bsc, solana.

limit.description: Maximum coins. Format: positive integer. Example: 20. Omit for the server's current cap.

min_liquidity.description: Minimum pool liquidity in USD. Format: a number. Example: 10000. Omit for no extra liquidity floor.

window.description: Volume window. Format: one of the allowed values. Example: 1h. Allowed values: 15m, 1h, 4h, 24h.

name: meme_trending
title: Trending meme coins + risk verdict ($0.005)
